name: Golden Thick-Cut French Toast with Syrup & Butter
whyItWorks: Soft thick Texas toast dipped in smooth beaten egg batter and cooked on a flat griddle provides easily absorbable carbohydrates and gentle protein with zero harsh roughage, making it a reliable warm breakfast choice.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for butter on the side and use pure maple syrup or pancake syrup in moderate amounts. Avoid ordering with powdered sugar dusting or side bacon if fat-sensitive.
